meta.source: split6 fusion; causal s10/s5 smoothed score
meta.calibration: current score mid-rank among all earlier evaluated scores of the same subject
meta.decision: fixed rank>=0.5, fixed rank>0.5 (ties negative), and crossfit training-fold threshold; threshold maximizes source-subject macro bACC
meta.selection: no score/calibration selection; s10 is primary and s5 is a robustness check
